card.name: Words just before a decimal or number
card.fires_on: Fires on a word or digit that sits right before a number-related word, such as the first digit of 2.4 or 24, or a number word before 'digit'. Also fires on 'Des' in 'Desensitization'.

modes.label: Digits starting a decimal or number
modes.description: The first digit of a figure like 2.4-GHz or 24 hour, or a number word before 'digit decimal'.

modes.label: Rounding and decimal instructions
modes.description: A small word in math or dose-rounding text that comes just before 'nearest tenth' or a decimal term.
modes.example: Round the total injection volume to<< the>> nearest tenth of a mL.

modes.label: Start of Desensitization
modes.description: The 'Des' piece at the start of the heading 'Anaphylactoid Reactions During Desensitization'.
modes.example: Anaphylactoid Reactions During<< Des>>ensitization Two patients undergoing desens
